Notes

  • Every photo is a real JAGG photo — the job gallery and the recent family set. Each post carries ten; five show in the grid and the rest open in the gallery, exactly how Facebook displays it.
  • The link appears in the post and again in the first comment. That is how the previous vendor ran all 258 posts, so it is the known-working pattern. Moving it to comment-only is a change worth testing later, not on week one.
  • Each post has its own tracking link, live now, so a lead traces back to the exact post and group that produced it.
  • Post 1's photos are stand-ins from the library. The real set is the Wantagh job, shot start to finish, which has the matching before and after.
  • The December 15 date is what gives the offer urgency — it needs to be a date JAGG will hold to.
  • Post 2 cites the JAGG Insurance Advantage and the 90-day and 1-year follow-ups, taken from JAGG's own published wording. Worth confirming it's still accurate.
